# No AI scraping or reuse requested

This website's owner requests that automated systems, including AI crawlers, not scrape, index, ingest, or use this site's content for model training, retrieval, or other AI purposes.

This file is a plain-language request, not a standardized access-control mechanism. For crawler directives, see `/robots.txt`. Compliance is voluntary; this file cannot prevent access by bots that ignore it.
